hook: A mother and her child, lifted out of Harvey's floodwater.
narration: A mother held her child in this basket as it rose out of Hurricane Harvey's floodwater.
The water around their home was still rising.
A Coast Guard aircrew lowered the basket and brought them up together.
Those orange floats keep the basket upright if it lands in water, [short pause] and the label tells everyone inside to stay seated.
outcome: The crew pulled the basket into the helicopter with mother and child aboard.
title: Mother and child lifted out of a flood
description:
A U.S. Coast Guard aircrew hoisted a mother and her child from rising floodwater in the aftermath of Hurricane Harvey in August 2017.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video (USCG Heartland), via Wikimedia Commons: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:United_States_Coast_Guard_aircrew_rescue_mother_and_child_from_rising_flood_waters_in_the_aftermath_of_Hurricane_Harvey.webm
